extracted.intended_audience: readers of public-domain fiction and Project Gutenberg users; ebook transcribers
extracted.subtask_description: Full-text Project Gutenberg edition of Harold MacGrath short stories (title story 'The Best Man' plus three others), intended as a readable e-book transcription of the original print work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Italics markup
rubrics_metrics.description: Text enclosed by underscores is in italics (_italics_).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transcriber's note specifies that italics in the original are represented by surrounding underscores in the plain-text eBook; preserve underscores to mark italics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small capitals substitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Small capitals were replaced with ALL CAPITALS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where the original used small-cap letters, the transcription uses full uppercase instead; maintain this substitution consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of additional stories
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the title story ('The Best Man') the original book contained three other stories by the same author, and they are included in this e-book: 'Two Candidates,' 'The Advent of Mr. 'Shifty' Sullivan,' and 'The Girl and the Poet.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transcriber's note lists and preserves the additional stories from the original volume as part of the e-book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illustrations placement
rubrics_metrics.description: The illustrations have been moved so that they do not break up paragraphs and so that they are next to the text they illustrate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Illustrations were repositioned for the e-book layout to avoid interrupting paragraph flow and to appear adjacent to the relevant text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ligature handling (oe)
rubrics_metrics.description: Throughout the document, the oe-ligature was replaced with 'oe'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All occurrences of the typographic œ ligature in the original are rendered as the two-letter sequence 'oe' in the transcription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialect/accent retention
rubrics_metrics.description: Throughout the dialogues, there were words used to mimic accents of the speakers. Those words were retained as-is.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transcription preserves original dialect spellings and accentive renderings found in dialogue rather than standardizing them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation and hyphenation corrections policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Errors in punctuation and inconsistent hyphenation were not corrected except that on page 210 a period was added after 'He was a failure'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The transcriber largely preserved original punctuation and hyphenation (including inconsistencies/errors), making only the single specified punctuation correction; follow a conservative 'preserve original' policy unless otherwise noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternate format / image availability notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Gutenberg also has an HTML version of this file which includes the original illustrations; images of the original pages are available through Internet Archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers seeking the illustrated/HTML layout or scanned page images are directed to the Project Gutenberg HTML/zip files and the Internet Archive copy; this note documents alternate distribution formats.
